name: NLCD TCC CONUS 2021 v2021-4
terms: Publicly distributed US government product; retain USFS/MRLC attribution
limitations: Modeled 2021 canopy, not current tree inventory. Metadata defines valid 0–100, non-processing 254, background 255. WCS incorrectly tags zero as nodata; reader uses published numeric range.

name: NLCD 2021 Land Cover L48
limitations: Water (11) and wetlands (90/95) are conservatively excluded. Does not resolve buildings, sidewalks or utilities.

name: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 summer 2024 snapshot
source_crs: Preserved per scene GeoTIFF and STAC item in raw/environment
terms: USGS Landsat open data; hosted asset access uses temporary signed URLs which are not stored in metadata
limitations: One scene per study selected for cloud-adjusted geographic overlap during July–August 2024; dates differ, not climatology. QA excludes fill, dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, cloud shadow, snow, water and radiometric saturation. Requires 50% valid coverage. Surface temperature retrieval, not observed air temperature.

name: CPAD 2026a holdings
provider: GreenInfo Network; California Department of Fish and Wildlife distribution
terms: CPAD attribution and State disclaimer; planning use, not a legal determination
limitations: Protected holdings flag review; no automatic exclusion or implied permission. Conservation easements not included.

name: USA Structures
provider: FEMA / ORNL; Esri US Federal Data distribution
source_crs: Service geometry reprojected explicitly to EPSG:4326
coverage: USA; study bounds queried by object IDs in complete batches
terms: Public FEMA-derived data; retain source attribution and dataset metadata
limitations: Image-derived footprints, may omit small/new structures; no utilities or parcel rights. Service can change; cached GeoJSON preserves retrieval.

name: NHD large-scale waterbodies
source_crs: Service geometry reprojected explicitly to EPSG:4326
limitations: NHD retired in 2023; local source vintages vary. Waterbody polygons supplement the NLCD water/wetland mask but do not cover every stream/coast/seasonal feature.
